items.label: Set Include
items.value: SHALL 4 piece flat pry bar set includes 5.5’’ mini pry bar, 7.5’’ nail remover tool, 10’’ medium-long crowbar and 15’’ heavy-duty utility pry bar; Four different sizes meet the needs of multiple tasks

items.label: High-Carbon Steel
items.value: SHALL nail puller is made of forged high-carbon steel with two-color metal spray treatment on surface, which is sturdy, durable, rust and corrosion resistant

items.label: Versatile Tool
items.value: The wonder bar has beveled edge with three nail slots at two ends, which is ideal for home remolding, woodworking projects and a wide variety of DIY tasks such as extracting different types of nails, lifting boards, prying apart plywood, scraping dirt, etc

items.label: Less Damage & Labor-saving Lever
items.value: The curved rocker head is round and the flat-pry end is slight bent to help improve leverage for easier prying and lifting without leaving indentations and scratches on the contact surface

items.label: Comfortable Grip
items.value: The edge of shaft is milling processed to provide comfortable grip and won’t cause pain when you grip it tightly
